svg.title: Clemson Go2 gesture and velocity guide
svg.desc: Eight illustrated gesture cards using hand landmark skeletons. Commands use default forward speed 0.5 metres per second and turn speed 0.8 radians per second.
svg.text: Match the direction in your mirrored hand panel. One gesture = one motion axis.
Index up; palm facing the webcam
